title: Destination C1&C2 · Unit 14 · L · Idioms · tr.118

parts.name: L · Idioms · tr.118
parts.instructions: Each of the words or phrases in [brackets] is incorrect. Write the correct word that belongs in the gap.

items.stem: I was hoping I'd raise about 1,000 euros for the local hospital, but I fell [small] by a few hundred euros.
items.explanation_vi: 'Fall short' là không đạt mức mong muốn.

items.stem: Jerry and I agreed to split the costs [twenty-twenty] so we'd each pay exactly half.
There are two ways to get to Innsbruck, but I think it's as [wide] as it's long.
items.explanation_vi: 'As broad as it's long' là hai cách như nhau.

items.stem: My dad taught me about the importance of saving money when I was knee-high to a [locust].
items.explanation_vi: 'Knee-high to a grasshopper' là còn rất nhỏ.

items.stem: So many politicians just seem to be trying to line their own [wallets] these days – it's disgraceful.
items.explanation_vi: 'Line your pockets' là vơ vét tiền cho mình.

items.stem: We shouldn't worry about paying for that advert. The cost is a drop in the [sea] in terms of the whole marketing budget.
items.explanation_vi: 'A drop in the ocean' là quá nhỏ, không đáng kể.

items.stem: I've decided to sell the whole business – lock, stock and [trigger].
items.explanation_vi: 'Lock, stock and barrel' là toàn bộ, không sót gì.

items.stem: Don't pay the whole bill. Let's go [half].
items.explanation_vi: 'Go halves' là chia đôi chi phí.

items.stem: There are two ways to get to Innsbruck, but I think it's six of one and half a [twelve] of the other.
items.explanation_vi: 'Six of one and half a dozen of the other' là như nhau.

items.stem: Lucy managed to save quite a [clean] sum last summer.
items.explanation_vi: 'A tidy sum' là món tiền khá lớn.

items.stem: We're not going to make a profit this year, but we should just break [equal].
Colin gets a new car every August. He's just trying to [stay] up with the Joneses, if you ask me.
items.explanation_vi: 'Keep up with the Joneses' là chạy đua với hàng xóm.
